title: Add a list item
summary: A list reducer can add a record with a stable id.
introduction: A list reducer can add a record with a stable id. Your task: Add a second book with a different id.
learningObjectives: Add a second book with a different id.
Explain the example for add a list item

blocks.text: A list reducer can add a record with a stable id. The payload supplies the record to add.
Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Add a list item

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createSlice` groups a state value and its reducer rules. Redux Toolkit also generates an action creator for each named reducer.
`payload` carries the data supplied with an action, such as an amount or a new record.

blocks.text: The new list contains a book titled Moon Trip.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create unique ids before dispatching or with a prepare callback. Do not use a random value inside a pure reducer.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a second book with a different id.
